verdict.rationale: Stripe documents machine/agent stablecoin payments via the x402 protocol (docs-16, docs-17) and recurring stablecoin withdrawal authorization (docs-4), showing some agent-payment-adjacent capability, but there is no documentation of a human configuring spend controls/limits that scope an agent's authority to move funds. missing for 10: explicit spend-control/authorization-limit configuration by a human, documented agent payout workflow with scoped permissions, and any hands-on or third-party confirmation of this flow working.
